overview_description: List account and sale order approvals, read one, and approve or reject a pending approval.
intro: Approvals hold an action until someone signs it off. You can list account and sale order approvals, read one account approval, and approve or reject a pending one. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
warning: **Approving or rejecting takes effect at once.** An approve runs the held action, and both send notifications.
notes: **Approve and reject name the record in the body.** Send `{"approval": {"entity": "account", "resource_id": "W13ZGY", "note": "Checked."}}`; the same two routes serve every entity that can need approval.
**The sale order listing path is camel case.** It is `/approvals/saleOrder`, not `sale_order`.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List account approvals
endpoints.summary: Lists the account approvals, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of account approvals under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: List sale order approvals
endpoints.summary: Lists the sale order approvals, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of sale order approvals under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. The path is written `saleOrder`, in camel case. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of sale order approvals.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an account approval
endpoints.description: Pass the `id` of an entry from the account approvals listing.

parameters.name: account_uuid
parameters.description: The `id` of an entry in the account approvals listing.

endpoints.title: Approve a pending approval
endpoints.summary: Approves a pending approval and runs the action it holds.
endpoints.description: Send the record to approve wrapped in `approval`, with its `entity`, its `resource_id` and a `note`. One route serves every entity. The held action runs and notifications go out straight away.

entity.description: The kind of record, such as `account`.

resource_id.description: The id of the record waiting for approval.

note.description: A note to keep with the decision.

endpoints.title: Reject a pending approval
endpoints.description: Send the same body as an approve: `entity`, `resource_id` and `note`, wrapped in `approval`. One route serves every entity, and notifications go out straight away.

entity.description: The kind of record, such as `account`.

resource_id.description: The id of the record waiting for approval.

note.description: A note to keep with the decision.

description.description: No type is known: this field is null in every record read.
